Section: 2. Procurement Authorization & Spending Approval Matrix

## 2. Procurement Authorization & Spending Approval Matrix

header: 2.1. Transaction Approval Thresholds (Single Purchase Order / Contract)
text:
Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 2.1. Transaction Approval Thresholds (Single Purchase Order / Contract)
Content:
### 2.1. Transaction Approval Thresholds (Single Purchase Order / Contract)
- **Tier 1 (Up to $1,000 USD):** Requires Direct Manager approval.
- **Tier 2 ($1,001 to $15,000 USD):** Requires Direct Manager and Department Head (Director) approval.
- **Tier 3 ($15,001 to $50,000 USD):** Requires Department Head, Procurement Lead, and Finance Controller approval.
- **Tier 4 (Over $50,000 USD):** Requires Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) sign-off, alongside competitive bidding documentation (minimum 3 vendor quotes).

Section: 2.2. Split Invoicing Prohibition (Anti-Structuring)
Content:
### 2.2. Split Invoicing Prohibition (Anti-Structuring)
- Intentionally splitting a single procurement order, software license batch, or service invoice into multiple smaller invoices to circumvent approval limits or bypass higher-tier authorization is strictly prohibited and constitutes an immediate audit violation.

Section: 3. Corporate Credit Card (P-Card) Governance
Content:
## 3. Corporate Credit Card (P-Card) Governance

Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 3.1. Card Usage & Permissible Expenses
Content:
### 3.1. Card Usage & Permissible Expenses
- Corporate P-Cards are issued solely for legitimate, pre-approved business operations, SaaS subscription renewals, emergency field supplies, and authorized business travel.
- P-Cards must never be used for personal expenses, personal cash advances, gambling, cryptocurrency transactions, or luxury/spa services.

text:
Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 3.2. Receipt Reconciliation & Settlement Timelines
Content:
### 3.2. Receipt Reconciliation & Settlement Timelines
- All P-Card transactions must be reconciled in the ERP system with itemized receipts uploaded within **7 business days** of transaction posting.
- Transactions exceeding **$50 USD** require an itemized digital tax invoice.
- If an employee fails to submit receipts within **30 calendar days**, the card will be suspended, and non-reconciled balances may be deducted from payroll.

Section: 4. Vendor Management, Consulting & Third-Party Contracting
Content:
## 4. Vendor Management, Consulting & Third-Party Contracting

Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 4.1. Vendor Due Diligence & Sanctions Screening
Content:
### 4.1. Vendor Due Diligence & Sanctions Screening
- All new commercial vendors, contractors, and service providers must complete vendor risk assessment (KYV), tax registration verification (W-9 / W-8BEN), and sanctions screening prior to contract execution or initial invoice payment.
- Emergency vendor onboarding without compliance clearance requires explicit written sign-off from the Head of Legal & Compliance.

text:
Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 4.2. Advance Payments & Retainers
Content:
### 4.2. Advance Payments & Retainers
- Advance payments to suppliers exceeding **30% of total contract value** are prohibited unless backed by a performance bank guarantee or approved by the Finance Controller.
- 100% upfront payment for software licenses is permitted only for standard commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) SaaS vendors with annual commitments under $25,000 USD.

Section: 5. Client Entertainment, Team Dinners & Gifts
Content:
## 5. Client Entertainment, Team Dinners & Gifts

Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 5.1. Client Entertainment & Dining
Content:
### 5.1. Client Entertainment & Dining
- Business meals hosted for prospective or active clients are reimbursable up to **$100 USD per attendee** (including taxes and gratuity up to 20%).
- Itemized dining receipts must list the names, affiliations, and business purpose of all attendees.
- Total entertainment spend exceeding **$1,000 USD for a single event** requires advance written authorization from the Department Vice President.

Section: 5.2. Internal Team Events & Celebrations
Content:
### 5.2. Internal Team Events & Celebrations
- Quarterly departmental team dinners or morale events are budgeted at a ceiling of **$40 USD per employee**.
- Internal milestone celebrations exceeding $500 USD total require prior manager approval.

Section: 6. Capital Expenditures (CapEx) & Asset Lifecycle
Content:
## 6. Capital Expenditures (CapEx) & Asset Lifecycle

Policy Document: expense_and_procurement_policy.md
Section: 6.1. Hardware & IT Equipment Procurement
Content:
### 6.1. Hardware & IT Equipment Procurement
- All laptops, monitors, servers, and telecommunication hardware must be procured exclusively via Centralized IT Procurement. Individual employee purchases of computing devices via expense reimbursement are strictly prohibited unless authorized during catastrophic field failure.
- Assets costing **$1,500 USD or greater** must be tagged in the Enterprise Fixed Asset Register with depreciation schedules.

Section: 7. Audit Compliance & Disciplinary Framework
Content:
## 7. Audit Compliance & Disciplinary Framework
1. All financial records, purchase orders, and expense claims are subject to quarterly internal audits and annual statutory review.
2. Submission of fraudulent invoices, fabricated receipts, unauthorized kickback arrangements, or intentional misallocation of budget codes will result in immediate termination and criminal referral.
